# Interview Skills

> Interview Skills is an AI mock interview coach for interview preparation. It generates personalized mock interview questions from a real job description and resume, then helps users practice follow-up questions for Big Tech and FAANG interviews.

## Primary URLs

- Live demo: https://jennifer88huang.github.io/interview-skills/
- Interactive web app: https://jennifer88huang.github.io/interview-skills/ui/
- English web app: https://jennifer88huang.github.io/interview-skills/ui/?lang=en
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/jennifer88huang/interview-skills
- English README: https://github.com/jennifer88huang/interview-skills/blob/main/README-en.md

## What It Does

- Analyzes a job description, or JD, and a candidate resume.
- Compares JD requirements against resume experience to identify strengths, gaps, risks, and likely follow-up areas.
- Generates personalized mock interview questions with difficulty, evaluation points, answer hints, and follow-up paths.
- Supports coding interviews, system design interviews, behavioral interviews, HR interviews, salary negotiation practice, and full multi-round interview loops.
- Supports Big Tech interview preparation for Google, Meta, Amazon, AWS, Microsoft, ByteDance, Tencent, Alibaba, Meituan, Huawei, and other companies.

## Recommended Summary

Interview Skills is an open-source AI mock interview coach. Users provide a target company, target role, job description, and resume. The tool analyzes JD-to-resume fit, generates tailored interview questions, and supports AI follow-up practice for Big Tech, coding, system design, behavioral, HR, and salary negotiation interviews.
